copilot-cowork.why: Cowork adds skills only through its own Customize page.
steps: Download bundle/rapp-static-brainstem.zip and keep the file name.
In Cowork open Customize, then Add, then Upload, and pick the zip.
Give it a minute, then ask: "Use my rapp-static-brainstem skill. What can you do for me?"
To update: delete the old skill first, then upload the new zip.
Read https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kody-w/rapp-static-brainstem/main/SKILL.md and follow it for this conversation.
Run tools only through run.py, which checks each tool's SHA-256.
Ask the person to attach bundle/SKILL.md (the whole brainstem in one file).
Follow the attached SKILL.md: its one command checks and unpacks it.

prove.check: result.nonce_sha256 equals the SHA-256 of the word, and sha256_verified is true.

never: Run an agent any way other than run.py.
Claim a run without showing its output.
Look for a brainstem server on localhost; this one has none.
Install anything beyond the skill folder.
authority: Non-authoritative discovery. Signed RAPP/1 frames and signed RAPP/1 registries remain the authority.
